Name: HammerAutoSwing
Author: sloth7777777777777
Description:
DescriptionThis SMAPI mod improves melee/tool feel in two ways: after a club/hammer ground slam, it automatically sends extra Use Tool inputs during the recovery window so combo-style damage lines up with vanilla timing; and for normal swings it applies a use-tool recovery cancel pattern (optional chord + tail) so recovery feels snappier on supported tools. Everything can be tuned in Generic Mod Config Menu or by editing [code]config.json[/code] next to the mod DLL.
[line]Installation instructions[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0 or newer).
[*]Unzip this mod so you get a folder like [code]HammerAutoSwingCancel[/code] containing [code]manifest.json[/code]
, [code]HammerAutoSwingCancel.dll
[/code], and the [code]i18n[/code] folder.
[*]Put that folder inside your game’s [code]Mods[/code] directory (same level as other mods, not nested inside another mod).
[*]Launch the game once so [code]config.json[/code] is created if needed.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings from the title menu.
[/list][line]Main features[list]
[*]Slam follow-up: After a hammer/club ground slam, pulses Use Tool during recovery (segment count, timing, Fast Animations tier, and recovery window are configurable).
[*]Swing recovery cancel: While holding Use Tool, simulates the cancel chord (with a short tail on release). Club/hammer, scythe, axe, pickaxe use a full hold loop; hoe and watering can use one pulse per press plus tail on release (see [code]config.json[/code] for tail / single-click padding if you need finer control).
[*]Localization: [code]i18n[/code] strings for GMCM (default + Chinese).
[*]No hard dependency on GMCM: the mod runs without it; you only lose the in-game settings UI.
[/list][line]Requirements[list]
[*]Stardew Valley with SMAPI 4.0.0+
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional; strongly recommended for easy configuration.
[*]If you use Fast Animations (or similar weapon-speed mods), align the slam tier setting with your setup so slam pulse timing stays sensible.
[/list][line]Shout outs[list]
[*]Pathoschild for SMAPI and the mod build tooling that makes packaging and deployment straightforward.
[*]spacechase9 for Generic Mod Config Menu, which keeps settings accessible without shipping a hard dependency.
[*]Everyone in the Stardew modding community whose docs, examples, and forum posts make features like this easier to ship.
[/list]

Manifest.Description: Requires SMAPI 4.0.0 or later. Slam follow-up for club/hammer. Swing cancel: melee 1.0-style; hoe/watering can send cancel keys after use-tool release (delayed into swing if still animating). Configure in GMCM or config.json.
